name: kolej-bilingual-v1
description: Eight invented policy documents from two fictional rail operators — four Polish (Kolej Nadwiślańska S.A.) and four English (Wolfsbane Interurban Rail). The two sets are deliberately parallel in structure and deliberately different in every number, so a question answered from the wrong document is visibly wrong rather than plausibly right. Nothing here describes a real company, and no fact in it exists outside this repository.
whyInvented: A benchmark built from real public documents cannot separate retrieval from recall: a model may already know the answer from pre-training, so a correct answer proves nothing. Every figure here was made up for this corpus, which makes a correct answer evidence that retrieval worked.

changelog: v1 (2026-09-12) — first run. Three questions had one- or two-digit answers that the no-retrieval control hit by chance, and four rubrics encoded expectations the documents contradict.

v2 (2026-09-12) — replaced the guessable questions with figures carrying a decimal; corrected the two refund-percentage rubrics, which forbade mentioning the full-refund clause the document actually contains, and the two comparison rubrics, which demanded the word 'longer' rather than the two figures. Results from v1 are kept in results/ and are not comparable with v2.
